monetianthus.primary: Friis et al 2009 DOI 10.1086/605120, full author-hosted text via Academia
monetianthus.findings: Holotype S122015 is ~3x2mm, partly inferior syncarpous 12-carpel gynoecium with central column. Only 10 elliptical outer bases/scars (one may be a bract) and 20 inner rhombic stamen bases survive. No complete petal or stamen reconstruction; outward free carpel tips with ventral crests. Compression and outer-organ phyllotaxis uncertain.

proterocladus.primary: Tang et al 2020 DOI 10.1038/s41559-020-1122-9, PMC8668152 author manuscript full text
proterocladus.findings: Uniseriate non-dichotomous asymmetric lateral branching below septa, branches bend upward, multiorder topology; shafts often widen distally. Sparse constrictions and occasionally cup/barrel/club/globose cells. 0.3-3.3mm thallus, rare discoidal/lobate holdfast. Labeled enlarged relief can preserve branching and gross widening without inventing fronds or microscopic pore/wall texture.

palaeocarpinus.primary: Sun and Stockey 1992 DOI 10.1086/297015, author-uploaded complete PDF
palaeocarpinus.findings: Selected P. joffrensis, original plate Figs1-16: holotype S26016A/B infructescence Figs1/2; fruit pair Fig4; equal opposite bracts Fig11; bilobed thorny bract Fig6. Small axis with cymules of two fruits, each oval nutlet individually surrounded by two deeply bilobed spiny bracts. Only fruiting organ, not foliage/pollen/staminate catkin.
